content: Mocking Prisma in tests (Prisma docs): singleton pattern (mockDeep<PrismaClient> in __mocks__ dir + vi.mock module) or dependency injection. vitest-mock-extended 5.x provides mockDeep/mockReset. Mock  as (callback)=>callback(prisma). Prisma's own 2026 testing series uses Vitest 4 specifically because Prisma emits ESM.
